## §S168 (2026-11-05) — LAW BATTERY RE-LANDING WAVE (post-recycle reconstruction)

**Recycle damage honestly recorded:** the S164–S167 law code was wiped by the sandbox recycle (the ledger description survived); the gmdice + Telegram anchor APKs and all backup binaries are gone with it. S168 rebuilt from the LIVE census of the 4 surviving corpus apps.

**Landed (local commit `52efa8fe`, push 403 — token write scope gone):**
1. **The live STUB census** (`MINIANDROID_S168_CENSUS=1`, bounded roll-up at process exit) — the P01/P03 capability re-landed; every run now names its stub face from data.
2. **The S168 law battery** (`MINIANDROID_S168_LAWS=1`, default OFF byte-inert) — 42 numbered laws / ~95 distinct signatures, each CENSUS-PROVEN or INERT-BY-VALUE, including the RL-DIGEST REAL OpenSSL EVP MessageDigest rung, the RL-CHARS toCharArray rung and the Html.fromHtml tag-strip content rung.
3. **The law-discipline discovery:** battery laws must never steal a deep side-effect path — intercepting `Window.getDecorView` (F023-PARENTLINK wiring) or `getLastNonConfigurationInstance` (V6-CTX-FALLBACK wiring) broke dooz composition (ViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner ISE ×4, then a SIGSEGV class) — caught by A/B bisect, removed, documented.

**Numbers (4-app A/B, binary `1e64ae389c3bd098`):** stubbed calls 230 → 6 (97.4% answered); dooz 139→2 + face byte-identical to pin `11a38a5aeeff45a6` BOTH arms; opencalc 68→4 byte-inert; microtimer 14→0 byte-inert; pf2048 9→0 with ONLY the named pager page-indicator dots rung (`eb5ebd559cad1028` → `03e73178622e4c80`); the wave-AD post-Skip pin `2d57a88d0e1d8930` reproduced byte-exact and byte-inert with laws ON; 0 NEW uncaught anywhere.

Full issue list + A/B table + honest remainders: #484 (wave S168 comment). Evidence: `evidence/s168_laws/{S168_CENSUS,S168_BATTERY_ON,S168_RESULTS}.json`.
